title: İyi Aile Yoktur - İyi Toplum Yoktur- Bütün Çocuklar İyidir
author: Nihan Kaya
description: In this groundbreaking trilogy, Nihan Kaya challenges deeply ingrained social norms around family, society, and childhood. In No Family is Truly Good, she questions the myth of the “ideal family,” exposing the invisible walls and emotional wounds created by stereotypes such as “family is everything” and “parents are sacred.” No Society is Truly Good examines how individuals are shaped to conform, how suppression beginning in childhood continues into adulthood, and how societal rules and boundaries alienate us from ourselves.
original_title: İyi Aile Yoktur - İyi Toplum Yoktur- Bütün Çocuklar İyidir
english_title: No Family is Truly Good / No Society is Truly Good / All Children are Good
